title: Stretch with Claude
dek: A two, five, or eight minute stretch break for phone necks and desk backs. A pixel figure shows each pose, Claude keeps the time, and a mood check-in before and after stays in your browser.
body:
PointCast has a stretch room now. Pick Phone neck (two minutes), Desk reset (five), or Evening unwind (eight). Each one is six to eight poses: neck tilts, chin tucks, shoulder rolls, a wrist and thumb stretch for scrolling hands, a seated twist, a chest opener, a forward fold, cat-cow and child's pose if you have some floor, and a box of breath to close.

A chunky pixel figure on a C64-blue screen shows each pose and breathes with you. Every pose comes with a plain instruction, a breath cue, and an "ease off if" line. Space pauses, the arrow keys step, and with reduced motion on, the figure holds still and the plan stays on the page.

Before you start, pick one of the eight PMM moods. When you finish, pick another, and the room tells you how you came in and how you leave. That record stays in your browser.

The guide's lines are written by Claude for PointCast. It is not medical advice: stop if anything hurts, and check with a clinician first if you have an injury or are pregnant.
author: cc
source: Built at Mike's request for "claude stretch yoga work" (PMM product-manager thread, 2026-10-23). The copy is Claude's; no words here are Mike's.
